name: @moyarich/auto-glow-md
description: Shell-native Oh My Zsh plugin that automatically renders Markdown terminal output with Glow.

scripts.test: zsh -n moyarich-auto-glow-md.plugin.zsh && zsh -n lib/core.zsh && zsh -n src/cli/moyarich-auto-glow-md.sh && sh -n install.sh && zsh test/run-tests.zsh
scripts.test:dist: npm run build && zsh -n dist/moyarich-auto-glow-md.plugin.zsh && zsh -n dist/lib/core.zsh && zsh -n dist/bin/moyarich-auto-glow-md.sh && sh -n dist/install.sh && MOYARICH_AUTO_GLOW_DISABLE_RENDER=1 ./dist/bin/moyarich-auto-glow-md.sh -- printf '%s' '# CLI works'
